description: Greenzie | Robotics Software Engineer (Experienced, 3–6 yrs) | Atlanta, GA | ONSITE/HYBRID | Full-time | https://greenzie.applytojob.com/apply/UdRcDlWSzs/Robotics-So... Greenzie builds the autonomy software that runs on commercial mowers. We don't sell the iron — Wright, Mean Green, Bobcat, and Greenworks Commercial do, with our stack on them. Mission is to free humans from repetitive outdoor labor. The software is on hundreds of machines in the field today. We're hiring an experienced roboticist who wants production robots doing real outdoor work, not lab demos. C++, Python, ROS/ROS2. You'll own a subsystem, debug messy field data, and ship to machines that mow for a living. Apply on that page and mention HN. Questions: cbq@greenzie.com
